Al utilizar la capa de la primera matriarca ganas los siguientes beneficios:

  • Tu CA pasa a ser 17.

  • Tu CD de hechizos aumenta +1.

  • Ganas resistencia al daño necrótico.

  • Ganas el cantrip Blood Bolt.

  • Podes Usar "Garden of the Blood Lily" una vez por día.

Blood Bolt (1 action casting time, 60 feet range, somantic and material component, you suffer 1 point of damage upon casting)

You transmute a drop of blood into a crimson dart and launch it at creatures within range, making a ranged spell attack. On hit, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage and 1d6 necrotic damage. The piercing and necrotic damage increase by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

Garden of the Blood Lily (1 action casting time, 60 feet range, VSM component, concentration 10 minutes)

You learned how to harness the power of the Blood Lily, a flower that exist between the material plane and the ethereal plane. You conjure up a field of blood Lillies, enveloping a 30 feet radius space in this life siphoning flowers.

Each creature must make a dex saving throw, if failed the creatures take 10d6 necrotic damage and half on success. If failed, the Lillies will keep attached to the body and they have to make a new dex saving throw or take 4d6 necrotic damage at the end of their turn.

For each creature that failed the saving throw the first time casted the caster regains 1d10 hit points.

Undead and Constructs are immune to this spells.

items.name: Spell Scroll: Protection from Evil and Good

description.value:
1st Level &Reference[Spell Scroll], Requires Concentration

Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them. If the target is already charmed, frightened, or possessed by such a creature, the target has advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

You regain 4d4+4 hit points when you drink this potion.

This silver crown of tangled branches is dotted with tiny jewels, with a larger diamond resting at its center. While wearing the crown, you can change the shape of your ears using a bonus action. You also gain the elf's Trance racial trait if you don't already have it.
The crown has 10 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d8 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn.

𝙎𝙥𝙚𝙡𝙡𝙨. While wearing the crown, you can use an action to expend 4 charges to cast the "dimension door" spell; alternatively, you can use a bonus action to expend 2 charges to cast the "misty step" spell.

𝙎𝙚𝙖𝙨𝙤𝙣 𝘾𝙝𝙖𝙣𝙜𝙚. When you first attune to the crown, and then again daily at dawn, you can choose a season for the crown to resonate with. When you do, the gemstones on the crown change color to match the respective season, and you gain resistance to the damage type associated with it. You can use a bonus action to expend 2 of the crown's charges to immediately change the associated season. Use the table below to determine what color and damage type is associated with each season.

| Season | Color | Damage Type | 
| Winter | Blue | Cold | 
| Spring | Green | Radiant |
| Summer | Gold | Fire | 
| Autumn | Orange | Necrotic |

Wondrous Item (requires attunement)

While wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You can't be targeted by such magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

Also, you can cast Greater Invisibility once per long rest.

Al inicio de tu turno, debes lanzar 1d6. Si sale 5-6, obtienes un uso de la habilidad "Aullido Etéreo". Aullido Etéreo: Con tu acción adicional, llamas a los espíritus aliados del plano etéreo para ayudarte en la batalla. Toda criatura que elijas en un rango de 60 pies debe hacer una tirada de salvación de sabiduría o ceder ante el aullido espiritual, haciendo visible a todos su espíritu. La primera vez que una criatura afectada por esto recibe daño, es convertido automáticamente en daño de fuerza y el efecto termina en esta criatura.

Una gema roja descansa en el centro de cada uno de estos pendientes oscuros, de cuya parte inferior cuelgan pequeñas cadenas. Mientras lleves puestos ambos pendientes, tienes resistencia al daño por fuego y puedes hablar, leer y escribir Infernal. Además, no puedes perderte por medios no mágicos mientras viajes por los Nueve Infiernos.

Resistencia Mágica: Toda tirada de salvación contra hechizos o efectos mágicos son realizados con ventaja (excepto que estos vengan de una fuente infernal)

Wondrous Item, Rarity Varies (Requires Attunement)

Roughly marble sized, Tymora's Stones are named after Tymora, the goddess of good fortune, luck, and victory revered on many worlds. Many types of Tymora's Stones exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you take a Magic action to toss a Tymora's Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Tymora's Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

Each Tymora's Stone orbiting your head is considered to be an object you are wearing. The orbiting stone avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to avoid collisions and thwarting all attempts by other creatures to attack or snatch it.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Tymora's Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to a Tymora's Stone ends while it’s orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

The type of stone determines its rarity and effects:

Sustenance (Rare)

You don’t need to eat or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head.
